source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 3 (PDF 37-48), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Object Oriented Programming Using Python) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name the three ideas that OOP emphasizes. What does this approach help to model?
(OOP kin teen tasawwurat par zor deta hai? Yeh andaz kis cheez ko model karne mein madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: OOP encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism par zor deta hai taake data aur behavior achhi tarah sambhale jayen. Yeh andaz haqeeqi duniya ke masail ko programming mein model karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This approach helps in modeling real-world problems in programming.

blocks.prompt:
2 Name the three main benefits of OOP given in the chapter.
(Chapter mein diye gaye OOP ke teen bare faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Modularity: code modules mein banta hai, sambhalna aasan.
2. Reusability: classes aur objects dobara istemal, takrar kam.
3. Aasan maintenance: aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system ko mutasir nahin karti.

book_ref.quote: OOP allows code to be divided into modules, making it easier to manage.

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between modularity and reusability.
(Modularity aur reusability mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Modularity program ko hisson mein baant'ti hai; reusability likha hua code dobara istemal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Reusability means using already written code again in different parts of a program or in other programs.

rows: Program ko chhote, qabil-e-intezam hisson mein baantna
Pehle se likha code dobara istemal karna
Har hissa alag banaya aur sambhala ja sakta hai
Code program ke doosre hisson ya doosre programs mein chalta hai
Code sambhalna aasan
Takrar kam

blocks.prompt:
4 Why are OOP programs easier to maintain and update?
(OOP programs ko maintain aur update karna kyun aasan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahin karti. Code alag classes aur modules mein hota hai, is liye aik hissa baqi ko chhede baghair update ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Programs built with OOP are easier to maintain and update because changes in one part do not affect the entire system.

blocks.prompt:
5 Besides modularity and reusability, give two more advantages of the structure of OOP.
(Modularity aur reusability ke ilawa OOP ke dhanche ke do aur faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Software development mein scalability aur adaptability ki madad karta hai.
2. Code ko samajh mein aane wala aur munazzam bana kar collaboration behtar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It also improves collaboration by making code more understandable and organized.

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between an attribute and a method.
(Attribute aur method mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Attribute property rakhta hai; method kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A class is a blueprint or template that defines the properties (attributes) and actions (methods) of an entity.

rows: Entity ki property (khoobi)
Entity ka action (kaam)
Value rakhta hai, maslan self.name
Class ke andar function, maslan display()
Har object ki apni value hoti hai
Call hone par object ke data par kaam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Write a class Car with an attribute brand and a method show() that prints it. Create one object and call show().
(Car class likhein jis mein brand attribute aur show() method ho jo use print kare. Aik object bana kar show() call karein.)

book_ref.quote: Classes and objects allow programmers to model real-world entities in code.

blocks.prompt:
8 What is self in a Python class?
(Python class mein self kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: self mojooda object ka reference (hawala) hai. Yeh instance methods ko khud ba khud milta hai, taake method usi object ka data (maslan self.name) istemal kare.

book_ref.quote: self is the reference to the current object, passed automatically to instance methods.

blocks.explanation:
Output:
12 75
Har object ki apni r value hai (2 aur 5), is liye area() ka nateeja alag hai.

book_ref.quote: Each object has its own data (Ali, Ahmed)

blocks.explanation:
Python object ko khud ba khud instance method mein bhejta hai, magar show() mein use lene ka parameter nahin, is liye TypeError aata hai.
Durust: def show(self):
class Test:
    def show(self):
        print("Hi")

Test().show()
Output:
Hi

book_ref.quote: self is the reference to the current object, passed automatically to instance methods.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Jab hum Test().show() likhte hain to Python andar se show(object) chalata hai. Agar show() mein self na ho to aik argument zyada pohanchta hai aur TypeError aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 How does Python signal how class data should be accessed?
(Python kaise batata hai ke class ke data tak kaise rasai ho?)
blocks.explanation: Java ya C++ ke bar-aks Python mein sakht private ya protected keywords nahin. Yeh naming conventions istemal karta hai: underscore nahin (public), aik _ (protected), do __ (private).

book_ref.quote: Instead, it relies on naming conventions to signal how data should be accessed.

blocks.prompt:
12 Name the three levels of access control in Python with the syntax of each.
(Python mein access control ke teen darje un ke syntax ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Public: self.attribute_name (har jagah se).
2. Protected: self._attribute_name (aik underscore).
3. Private: self.__attribute_name (do underscores).

book_ref.quote: In Python, you can control the visibility of class members using specific naming prefixes:

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between public and private members.
(Public aur private members mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Public members sab ke liye khule hain; private members class ke bahar se chhupe hain.

book_ref.quote: These are accessible from anywhere—inside or outside the class.

rows: Class ke andar aur bahar har jagah se mil sakta hai
Sakht pabandi; class ke bahar se aasani se nahin milta
Syntax: self.attribute_name
Syntax: self.__attribute_name (do underscores)
Default se sab members public hain
Python name mangling se ittefaqi rasai rokta hai

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between protected and private members.
(Protected aur private members mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Protected sirf ishara hai; private ko name mangling bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: These are intended for internal use within the class and its subclasses.

rows: Aik underscore: self._attribute_name
Do underscores: self.__attribute_name
Class aur us ki subclasses ke andar istemal ke liye
Class tak sakhti se mehdood
Sirf convention, pabandi nahin; bahar se rasai phir bhi hoti hai
Name mangling andaruni naam badal deti hai, bahar se seedhi rasai nakam

blocks.prompt:
15 What is name mangling?
(Name mangling kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Name mangling Python ka woh tareeqa hai jo private members (do underscores) ke liye variable ka andaruni naam badal deta hai taake class ke bahar se ittefaqi rasai na ho.

book_ref.quote: Python uses a mechanism called Name Mangling to change the internal name of the variable to prevent accidental access.

blocks.prompt:
16 Is _private_variable a private variable in Python? Give a reason.
(Kya _private_variable Python mein private variable hai? Wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Aik underscore protected member ki nishani hai, jo sirf convention hai. Private member ke liye do underscores chahiyein: self.__attribute_name.

book_ref.quote: Syntax: self._attribute_name (single underscore)

blocks.explanation:
Output:
Insufficient balance
1500
withdraw(2500) 2000 se zyada hai, is liye message aata hai; phir 2000 + 700 - 1200 = 1500.

book_ref.quote: Private Members: These are highly restricted and cannot be easily accessed from outside the class.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why does the last line of this program fail? How should the balance be read?

class BankAccount:
    def __init__(self, balance):
        self.__balance = balance

acc = BankAccount(2000)
print(acc.__balance)
(Is program ki aakhri line kyun nakam hoti hai? Balance kaise parhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: __balance private member hai; name mangling us ka andaruni naam badal deti hai, is liye class ke bahar se seedhi rasai AttributeError deti hai. Balance class ke method, maslan get_balance(), se parhna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Python uses a mechanism called Name Mangling to change the internal name of the variable to prevent accidental access.

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain encapsulation with the real-life example of a bank account.
(Encapsulation ko bank account ki haqeeqi misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bank account mein balance chhupa hota hai. Use sirf deposit() aur withdraw() se istemal kiya ja sakta hai; koi seedha balance nahin badal sakta. Data chhupa kar sirf methods se rasai dena encapsulation hai.

book_ref.quote: You cannot directly change the balance; this is encapsulation.

blocks.prompt:
20 Give any four reasons why encapsulation is important.
(Encapsulation ke ahem hone ki koi chaar wajoohat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data ko ghair-zaroori rasai se bachati hai.
2. Security behtar karti hai.
3. Code sambhalna aasan karti hai.
4. Control ke saath tabdeeli ki ijazat deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Allows controlled modification

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between a parent class and a child class.
(Parent class aur child class mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Parent apni properties deti hai; child unhein leti hai.

book_ref.quote: Child Class (Derived Class): The class that inherits from the parent.

rows: Base class ya superclass bhi kehlati hai
Derived class ya subclass bhi kehlati hai
Jis class ki properties inherit hoti hain
Jo class parent se inherit karti hai
Misal: Animal
Misal: Dog, likhte hain class Dog(Animal):

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a subclass? What two things can it do with the features of its parent class?
(Subclass kya hai? Yeh parent class ke features ke saath kaun se do kaam kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Subclass woh nayi class hai jo doosri (parent) class se properties aur methods leti hai. Yeh (1) naye features jor sakti hai aur (2) parent ke features badal sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The new class, called a subclass, can add or modify features of the parent class.

blocks.prompt:
23 What is method overriding? Write the role of super() in it.
(Method overriding kya hai? Is mein super() ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Method overriding: child class parent mein pehle se maujood method ka apna khaas version deti hai. super() function child ke andar parent wala version call karne ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Method Overriding: A child class can provide a specific implementation of a method that is already provided by its parent.

blocks.explanation:
Output:
Employee details
Manages a team
Manager ne info() override kiya; super().info() pehle parent wala version chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: You can use the super() function to call the parent

blocks.prompt:
25 Define single inheritance and give an example from the chapter.
(Single inheritance ki definition likhein aur chapter se misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Single inheritance mein child class theek aik parent class se attributes aur methods leti hai. Misal: Dog, Animal se inherit karti hai; use eat() milta hai aur woh apna bark() jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: This is the most fundamental form of inheritance in Python, promoting code reusability

blocks.explanation:
Output:
BookMart is open
BookMart delivers at home
OnlineShop ko Shop se __init__ aur open() milte hain aur woh deliver() jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: allowing the child class to extend or modify the behavior of the parent

blocks.prompt:
27 Define multiple inheritance. Write the class header for a class Smartphone that inherits from Camera and Computer.
(Multiple inheritance ki definition likhein. Camera aur Computer se inherit karne wali Smartphone class ka header likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Multiple inheritance mein aik class aik se zyada parent classes se attributes aur methods leti hai.
Header: class Smartphone(Camera, Computer):

book_ref.quote: Multiple inheritance in Python allows a single class to inherit features (attributes and methods) from more than one parent class.

blocks.explanation:
Output:
Playing
Teaching
Training
Coach, Teacher aur Player dono se inherit karti hai, is liye play(), teach() aur apna train() chala sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: It can access methods from both parent classes.

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between multiple inheritance and multilevel inheritance.
(Multiple inheritance aur multilevel inheritance mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Multiple: aik class, kai parents. Multilevel: classes ki zanjeer.

book_ref.quote: creating a chain of inheritance similar to a family tree (Grandparent → Parent → Child)

rows: Aik class aik se zyada parents se inherit karti hai
Class aik derived class se inherit karti hai
Parents barabar: class Child(Father, Mother):
Zanjeer: Grandparent → Parent → Child
Misal: Smartphone, Camera aur Computer se
Misal: ElectricCar, Car se, aur Car, Vehicle se

blocks.prompt:
30 In the chapter's multilevel example, which methods can an ElectricCar object use, and where is each defined?
(Chapter ki multilevel misal mein ElectricCar object kaun se methods istemal kar sakta hai aur har aik kahan define hai?)
blocks.explanation:
start_engine(): Vehicle (grandparent) mein.
drive(): Car (parent) mein.
charge(): khud ElectricCar mein.
Grandchild ko parent aur grandparent dono ke methods milte hain.

book_ref.quote: In this example, ElectricCar inherits from Car, which in turn inherits from Vehicle.

blocks.explanation:
Output:
College
School
University
University, College se aur College, School se inherit karti hai, is liye u teeno darjon ke methods chala sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Multilevel inheritance in Python occurs when a class inherits from another derived class

blocks.prompt:
32 Explain polymorphism with the chapter's payment-system example.
(Polymorphism ko chapter ki payment system misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Payment system mein Credit Card, UPI, NetBanking aur Wallet hain. Sab processPayment() istemal karte hain magar har aik ka apna tareeqa hai; NetBanking mein yeh bank login par le jata hai. Naam wahi, kaam payment type ke mutabiq badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The method name remains the same, but the action changes based on the payment type.

blocks.prompt:
33 Name the two main types of polymorphism and how each is achieved.
(Polymorphism ki do bari qismein aur har aik ke hasil hone ka tareeqa likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Compile-time polymorphism: aam taur par method ya operator overloading se.
2. Runtime polymorphism: method overriding se.

book_ref.quote: It mainly includes compile-time and runtime polymorphism

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between compile-time and runtime polymorphism.
(Compile-time aur runtime polymorphism mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke chalne wala method kab tay hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Compile-time polymorphism means deciding which method or operation to run during compilation

rows: Compilation ke waqt tay hota hai
Program chalte waqt object ke mutabiq tay hota hai
Aam taur par method ya operator overloading se
Method overriding se
Asal shakal Java ya C++ mein; Python default aur variable-length arguments se naql karta hai
Python ki dynamic fitrat ise khaas taur par taaqatwar banati hai

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between method overloading and method overriding.
(Method overloading aur method overriding mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Overloading: aik method, mukhtalif inputs. Overriding: parent ke method ka child wala version.

book_ref.quote: This happens through Method Overriding a child class provides its own version of a method already defined in the parent class.

rows: Aik hi method mukhtalif tadaad ya qism ke inputs ke saath chalta hai
Child class parent mein maujood method ka apna version deti hai
Compile-time polymorphism
Runtime polymorphism
Python mein default arguments ya *args se, maslan multiply()
Misal: Animal ka sound(), Dog aur Cat mein override

blocks.prompt:
36 Why does Python not need signature-based method overloading? How is similar behavior achieved?
(Python ko signature par mabni method overloading ki zaroorat kyun nahin? Is jaisa rawayya kaise hasil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python dynamically typed hai, is liye aik function mukhtalif types ke arguments le sakta hai. Is jaisa rawayya default arguments, variable-length arguments (*args, **kwargs) ya function ke andar conditions se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Because Python is dynamically typed, a single function can accept arguments of different types, making signature-based overloading unnecessary.

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the output of the following program. Which idea of the chapter does it show?

class Greeter:
    def hello(self, name="Guest"):
        print("Hello", name)

g = Greeter()
g.hello()
g.hello("Ali")
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output likhein. Yeh chapter ka kaun sa tasawwur dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Output:
Hello Guest
Hello Ali
Aik hi method default argument se zero ya aik argument ke saath chalta hai; yeh compile-time polymorphism (method overloading) ki naql hai.

book_ref.quote: Instead, similar behavior can be achieved using default arguments

blocks.prompt:
38 Write the output of the following program.

class Marks:
    def total(self, *args):
        result = 0
        for m in args:
            result += m
        return result

t = Marks()
print(t.total(40, 35))
print(t.total(40, 35, 25))
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Output:
75
100
*args jitni chahein values jama karta hai: 40 + 35 = 75 aur 40 + 35 + 25 = 100.

book_ref.quote: This code demonstrates method overloading using default and variable-length arguments.

blocks.explanation:
Output:
Swims
Moves
Flies
Runtime polymorphism: move() Bird aur Fish mein override hai, aur har object ki class ke mutabiq chalte waqt sahi version chunta hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, sound method behaves differently depending on whether object is a Dog, Cat or Animal

blocks.prompt:
40 Show with one print statement how the same operator can behave differently with different objects.
(Aik print statement se dikhayein ke aik hi operator mukhtalif objects ke saath kaise alag kaam karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
print(10 + 5, "10" + "5")
Output:
15 105
+ operator numbers ko jorta (jama) aur strings ko milata hai.

book_ref.quote: Technically, Polymorphism allows the same method, function, or operator to behave differently
